lessons.keep: Keep a stable image composition while highlighting one visible edit at a time.
lessons.avoid: Avoid presenting animated results or a promotional chart as independent speed or accuracy proof.
lessons.open: Exact transitions, real latency, preservation of untouched pixels and sound remain open.
try: For Tin creative revisions, use the same ad image for headline, product and crop changes; label each selected target with a colored pointer.
Compare a result with its previous version using a circular detail crop on the changed region, then return to the full ad.

comparison.story: Introduce image editing through composition. → Claim fast edits at competitive quality. → Show selected changes within a stable scene. → Extend the consistency claim beyond one example. → Show a compact editing interaction. → Close on the brand.
